reviews.text: The company is very professional and friendly, all work to be done is clearly explained to the customer and questions or concerns are answered.

reviews.text: David and his team at Cozy Penguin were excellent. They really took pride in their work, showed up on time ( and a bit early ), kept me in the loop, answered questions. Highly recommend them.
